title: eriolobus trilobatus
intro: Eriolobus trilobatus, commonly known as the Chinese globe flower or globe-flower, is a plant species native to China. It is a small, deciduous shrub with fragrant flowers that have been used in traditional Chinese medicine for centuries. The health benefits of Eriolobus trilobatus include its anti-inflammatory, antibacterial, and antioxidant properties, which can help to reduce pain and inflammation, and protect against oxidative stress. The bioactive constituents of the plant include trilobatin, eriolobine, and other alkaloids, which exhibit therapeutic actions such as analgesic, anti-inflammatory, and vasodilatory effects.
